heroHeadline: EU Condemns Trump-Russia Diesel Deal as Funding War, Undermining Sanctions Coalition
heroSubtitle: Drone strikes on the Northern and Southern bridges have fully or partly closed three of Kyiv's six Dnipro road crossings, while glide bombs hit Kharkiv. At least 26 civilians have been killed since Oct. 1.
